svg.title: What decontX does
svg.desc: Top: a droplet holds a B cell and ambient RNA from other cells, so its counts include T cell and monocyte markers; decontX() or decontPro() removes them and keeps the B cell marker. Bottom: on a UMAP before decontamination, contaminated cells blur toward the middle and a T cell marker appears in B cells and monocytes; after, the clusters are tighter and the marker stays in T cells.
svg.text: a B cell, plus ambient RNA
markers of other cell types show up
only the cell's own counts remain

g.text: ambient RNA from other cell types

svg.text: Across all cells: a T cell marker on a UMAP

g.text: contaminated cells blur toward the middle,
and the T cell marker shows up in other cells
tighter clusters; the T cell marker
